basis: Neoplasm arises in the ocular choroid; its vascular classification does not imply systemic cardiovascular involvement.
Defined by defective renal tubular transport; specific electrolyte and metabolic abnormalities vary across subtypes.
Lateral ocular misalignment is an eye motility disorder.
Arrhythmogenic myocardial disease classified as an inborn mitochondrial metabolic disorder; extracardiac structural abnormalities are rare.
Inherited platelet deficiency, with thrombocytopenia in 10/10 patients; reduced thrombopoietin does not establish endocrine gland disease.
Immunodeficiency, congenital myopathy and ectodermal dysplasia define the syndrome; enamel defects occur in 80-99%; iris hypoplasia omitted by cap. Infections are separate diseases.
Syndrome characterized by tibial/radial skeletal anomalies, osteopenia, fractures and developmental disability.
Defined as a bilirubin metabolism disorder; elevated circulating bilirubin alone establishes neither liver nor blood-cell damage.
In situ carcinoma originates in oral mucosa, which belongs to the gastrointestinal axis.
Combined antibody deficiency; psoriasiform dermatitis affects 1/3 (~33%). Diarrhea alone does not establish intestinal damage; recurrent sinusitis is a separate infection.
Postaxial extra digits define the skeletal malformation; nail dysplasia occurs in only 1/10 patients.
Congenital absence of thigh and lower-leg skeletal structures with preservation of the foot.
FOXE3-associated cataract affects the lens; associated corneal opacity remains within the ocular axis.
Multisystem autoimmunity; renal injury with proteinuria in 2/2 and nephrotic disease in 1/2; colitis in 1/2. Skin IgG deposits alone do not establish damaging skin disease.
Skeletal/cartilage defects and pulmonary artery stenoses define it; airway abnormalities 80-99%, hearing loss 12/17 (~71%). Developmental delay 10/17 (~59%) omitted by cap.
Umbrella disorder of sulfur compound metabolism; no additional organ injury is established across most subtypes.
Inherited myopia is a refractive and ocular growth disorder.
Immune-complex deposition damages glomeruli and causes membranous nephropathy; no additional organ is intrinsic to the umbrella disease.
IgE-mediated hypersensitivity defines the mechanism; affected anatomical sites vary across allergic disease subtypes.
Spinal and brainstem motor-neuron degeneration; denervation causes skeletal muscle wasting and loss of function in nearly all patients.
Posterior corneal ectasia and opacity define the disorder; supplied skeletal, developmental and urinary findings lack frequencies establishing common involvement.
Adult teratomas are predominantly gonadal, outside these axes; CNS and other anatomical sites define specific subtypes rather than the adult umbrella.
Hematologic disorder defined by monoclonal immunoglobulins; renal, neurologic and skeletal damage is not common across the umbrella.
Intramural outpouchings of gallbladder mucosa; the gallbladder belongs to the hepatic axis.
Carcinoma originates in the colon; neuroendocrine differentiation alone does not establish an endocrine disorder.
